scripts.sync: npm --prefix ../.. run build:native && npm run sync:web && cap sync android
scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest
scripts.android:open: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.android:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.release:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
